metas.name: 1 · ★ 3.3 · 2013 · Sharknado
metas.description: When a freak hurricane swamps Los Angeles, nature's deadliest killer rules sea, land, and air as thousands of sharks terrorize the waterlogged populace.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.0 · 2014 · Sharknado 2: The Second One
metas.description: Fin and April are on their way to New York City, until a category seven hurricane spawns heavy rain, storm surges, and deadly Sharknadoes.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.1 · 2015 · Sharknado 3: Oh Hell No!
metas.description: A monstrous tornado unleashes ravenous sharks from Washington, D.C., all the way down to Orlando, Florida.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.9 · 2016 · Sharknado 4: The 4th Awakens
metas.description: Fin, his family and the cosmos have been blissfully sharknado-free in the five years since the most recent attack, but now sharks and tornadoes are being whipped up in unexpected ways and places.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 3.8 · 2017 · Sharknado 5: Global Swarming
metas.description: With much of America lying in ruins, the rest of the world braces for a global sharknado, and Fin and his family must travel around the world to stop them.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 3.6 · 2018 · The Last Sharknado: It's About Time
metas.description: Fin has to go back in time to rejoin his shark-battling friends to stop the first Sharknado and save humanity.
